summary: Tested new Site Theme & Links feature end-to-end. Backend: GET /api/site-settings and PUT /api/admin/site-settings (auth, persistence, theme_updated_at stamping, lock toggle) via pytest (/app/backend/tests/test_site_settings.py) — 5/6 passed. Frontend: admin login -> /admin/site (nav admin-nav-site), theme/primary/lock/social inputs + save + persistence after reload all worked; public site adopted admin theme (body 'light-theme theme-nature has-theme', --emerald=#2f8a3b), footer showed <a target=_blank> for set links and greyed social-icon-off spans for empty ones; stale appThemeStamp forced adoption; user-chosen dracula persisted across reload; with theme_locked=true theme-palette-btn and theme-toggle-btn were absent and admin theme applied. Cleanup done: default_theme=light, default_primary='', theme_locked=false, all social links empty (verified via GET).

minor.issue: No validation of default_theme against the allowed THEME_KEYS list — 'not-a-theme' is accepted (200) and served by public GET /api/site-settings. Frontend ignores unknown values so site falls back to previous theme, but invalid data can be persisted. Same for default_primary (non-hex strings accepted; UI validates only client-side).

integration_issues.flow: Visitor changes theme after admin set a default_primary
integration_issues.issue: Minor/by-design? Choosing a different theme via theme-palette-btn keeps the admin-pushed default_primary override in localStorage (appPrimary), so e.g. dracula renders with the admin's green accent until the visitor clears the primary. Confirm this is intended.

action_items: Optional: validate default_theme (whitelist) and default_primary (#RRGGBB) server-side in PUT /api/admin/site-settings, return 400 otherwise.
critical_code_review_comments: update_site_settings accepts a raw dict body without Pydantic validation — add a model with a theme Literal/enum and hex regex for default_primary.
Footer.jsx and ThemeContext.js each call GET /site-settings separately on every page load (duplicate request); could be shared via ThemeContext.

success_rate.backend: 83% (5/6; single failure is the report-only theme validation check)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily set site settings (nature/#2f8a3b + facebook/youtube links, then locked) for testing; all restored to defaults at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site settings tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_site_settings.py (module-scoped restore fixture resets theme to light). Public-site theme adoption depends on localStorage keys appTheme/appPrimary/appThemeStamp; admin token key is 'he_admin_token_v1'.
rca_of_the_issue: Only defect found: PUT /api/admin/site-settings coerces every field to a trimmed string with no whitelist, so arbitrary default_theme values persist; ThemeContext guards with THEME_KEYS so no visible breakage.
